questions.solution:

45 + 15 = 60

Only option which follow this logic is 55 : 70 i.e.

55 + 15 = 70

Hence, “55 : 70” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.

9, 16, 13, 12, 17, 8, ?, ?
questions.solution:
This series is combination of two series which are placed alternately,

Series I : 9, 13, 17, ?

9 + 4 = 13

13 + 4 = 17

17 + 4 = **21**

Series II : 16, 12, 8, ?

16 – 4 = 12

12 – 4 = 8

8 – 4 = **4**

Hence, 21, 4 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Present age of Vikas and Raman are in the ratio of 6 : 5 respectively. If the present age of Rohan is 98 years and the present age of Vikas is 3/7 of the the present age of Rohan, then after how many years the ages of Vikas and Raman would be in the ratio of 7 : 6?
questions.solution:
1) The present age of Rohan is 98 years and the present age of Vikas is 3/7 of the present age of Rohan

Vikas age = 3/7 (98)

= 42 years

2) The present age of Vikas and Raman are in the ratio of 6 : 5

6x = 42

X = 7

Therefore Raman present age will be 5x = 5 × 7 = 35 years.

Vikas : Raman age after some years will be 7 : 6

Vikas : Raman = 42 : 35

42 + x / 35 + x = 7 / 6

X = 7.

Hence after 7 years, the ratio of Vikas and Raman will be in ratio 7 : 6.

questions.question:
In the question two statements are given, followed by two conclusions, I and II. You have to consider the statements to be true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions, if any, follows from the given statements.

**Statement I:** All cards are labels

**Statement II:** No posters are labels

**Conclusion I:** No cards are posters

**Conclusion II:** Some posters are cards

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows

questions.solution:
**Statement I:** All cards are labels

**Statement II:** No posters are labels

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f81c00408fda40a65d8b76ab3484a3290f5dcf036fdbc42e7ad64ad52215ce44.png] 

**Conclusion I:** No cards are posters → True

**Conclusion II:** Some posters are cards → False ( No posters are labels and All cards are labels)

Hence, Only Conclusion I follows.
